verdict.rationale: ClickHouse ships an official MCP server (mcp-clickhouse) letting AI assistants connect and run queries against ClickHouse, and docs mention agent skills/CLI integration, so agents can execute SQL through a sanctioned tool interface. However, none of the evidence describes scoped tool definitions that explicitly separate read-only queries from destructive/schema-changing operations, nor any permissioning model for safe delegation. missing for 10: documentation of read-only vs write/destructive tool scoping, permission controls or guardrails within the MCP server, independent confirmation that agents can't run destructive ops unintentionally.
